transcription: faithful compact transcription of the final read-only review; the full session is retained at the source_session path and bound by SHA-256

findings.title: Reviewer concluded that the forced-volume filename was not assigned
findings.required_action: Prove the exact ADflow-internal filename assignment and watched path before reconsideration.
findings.lead_researcher_disposition: REBUTTAL_PENDING_COMMIT: installed pyADflow.py calls _setForcedFileNames immediately after setAeroProblem and assigns inputio.forcedvolumefile to <outputDirectory>/<aeroProblem.name>_forced_vol.cgns; exact source evidence will be recorded and independently re-reviewed.

findings.title: Structural checkpoint validation omits ADflow ReferenceState requirements
findings.required_action: Require finite ReferenceState Density, Pressure and Mach_Velocity values, require positive density/pressure, and describe checkpoints as structurally validated until a separately authorized restart round-trip is executed.

findings.title: The resource sampler pauses during synchronous checkpoint validation and the 9.2 GiB estimate lacks itemized checkpoint allowances
findings.required_action: Use a dedicated continuous sampler, report maximum sampling gap, add explicit write/validation allowances and a MemAvailable preflight bound, and mark bytes-per-cell as derived.

findings.title: The 1e-11 stop extrapolates the old-mesh ANK trend without a defined stagnation outcome
findings.required_action: Add a governed density-residual slope diagnostic and a defined recorded stagnation outcome; explicitly disclose mesh-change uncertainty and avoid presenting the fitted runtime as guaranteed.

findings.title: Projected facewise y+ correspondence relies on zone and element ordering
findings.required_action: Strengthen the ordering assertion while retaining projection-only status.

findings.title: In-process CGNS validation could make watchdog robustness depend on the CGNS library
findings.required_action: Keep resource monitoring independent of validation and fail closed on validator failure.

findings.title: Checkpoint filenames are numbered but not bound to a recorded solver state
findings.required_action: Record nonlinear iteration, total minor iteration and component residual snapshot with every checkpoint.

findings.title: The native write-volume flag is mutable
findings.required_action: Assert and record monitor.writevolume immediately before the solver call.
